name.Description: Bipolar channel name exactly as in the source (one row per bipolar channel; position is the midpoint of its two contacts).

region_id.Description: Source region number (1-38 atlas regions for 1min/10min; 1-17 regions for HFO set).

manufacturer.Description: Electrode manufacturer derived from electrode_type per source readme

source_channel_name.Description: Channel name in the source file
